title: Profile
nickNameLength: Nickname must be 30 characters or fewer
emailLength: Email must be 50 characters or fewer
passwordSame: The new password must differ from the current one
passwordMismatch: The new passwords do not match
passwordChangedDesc: You stay signed in here. Sessions on other devices remain valid; sign them out under "Signed-in devices" if needed.
devicesDesc: Sessions signed in with this account. If you don't recognize a device, sign it out and change your password.
logoutDeviceDesc: The session ends immediately and must sign in again.
socialDesc: Third-party accounts linked to this account. You can link or unlink them here.
unbindDesc: You can no longer sign in with that account until you link it again.
socialNotConfigured: No third-party sign-in has been configured by the administrator, so there is nothing to link yet.
authorizeUrlInvalid: The authorization URL is invalid. Ask the administrator to check the third-party sign-in settings.
bindFailedDesc: Go back to your profile and try linking again.
callbackMissing: The authorization callback is missing the platform, code or state. Go back to your profile and try linking again.
